target.title: feat(web): Switchboard keycap redesign (before/after)
target.body:
## Switchboard redesign

ClickClack means keycaps. This redesign leans into it: the app now reads as a mechanical board — cool porcelain surfaces over a dot-grid mounting plate in light mode, an anodized navy-black "night board" in dark mode, and controls that behave like keys (hard 1px edge shadow, raised on hover, pressed flat on `:active`).

### What changed

- **Palette**: warm paper/ember → cool ink. Electric cyan interaction accent, cobalt brand gradient, indigo agent-delivery + amber working-log tones (still distinct hues per the two-tone agent-turn model), all via the existing token system in `base.css`.
- **Tactility**: shared `--key-edge` / `--key-edge-pressed` tokens drive keycap treatment on workspace tiles, topbar actions, the send button, the composer card, the auth panel, and `kbd` chips.
- **Type**: Bricolage Grotesque (variable) for display moments — workspace name, channel title, auth, empty states. Body stays Geist. Machine metadata (timestamps, section labels, day dividers, bot chips, row stamps) moves to Geist Mono via a new `--font-mono` token, which also replaces the scattered ad-hoc mono stacks.
- **Texture**: dot-grid plate on the guild rail and auth shell; cool signal glows replace the warm radials.
- **Cleanups**: tooltips lose the last hardcoded espresso colors (now `--tooltip-bg`/`--tooltip-fg` tokens), sharper radii scale, skeleton/avatar radii matched.

No markup or behavior changes — the diff is CSS tokens + component styles plus one font dependency.

### Before / after

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| **Light** | ![before light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard/docs/proof/switchboard-before-chat-light.png) | ![after light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard/docs/proof/switchboard-after-chat-light.png) |
| **Dark** | ![before dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard/docs/proof/switchboard-before-chat-dark.png) | ![after dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openclaw/clickclack/redesign/switchboard/docs/proof/switchboard-after-chat-dark.png) |

Shots: 1440×900 against the dev-bootstrap workspace; PNGs live in `docs/proof/switchboard-*` per repo convention.

### Verification

- `pnpm fmt:ts:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build:web` all green.
- Verified live in the browser (light + dark), no console errors.
- Autoreview (Codex gpt-5.6-sol, xhigh): two findings — light-theme brand-gradient contrast (fixed: cyan stop held at #0072b0, ≥4.5:1 for white 14px lettering) and a specificity bug that kept the home tile from its pressed state (fixed with an equally specific `:active` rule). Final run clean.

Product site (`ProductSite.svelte` / `product.css`) is intentionally untouched; it can follow in a companion PR if we like this direction.
